name.text: Points on the axes and coordinate planes

questiontext.text:
Where is each point? Choose from the list.

generalfeedback.text:
Count the zero coordinates. One zero puts a point in a coordinate plane: z = 0 is the xy-plane, x = 0 the yz-plane and y = 0 the xz-plane. Two zeros put it on an axis, where two planes meet.

  • \(({@p1[1]@},\,{@p1[2]@},\,{@p1[3]@})\): [[if test="is(c1=1)"]]on the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c1=2)"]]on the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c1=3)"]]on the z-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c1=4)"]]in the xy-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c1=5)"]]in the yz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c1=6)"]]in the xz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c1=7)"]]in no coordinate plane[[/if]].
  • \(({@p2[1]@},\,{@p2[2]@},\,{@p2[3]@})\): [[if test="is(c2=1)"]]on the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c2=2)"]]on the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c2=3)"]]on the z-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c2=4)"]]in the xy-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c2=5)"]]in the yz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c2=6)"]]in the xz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c2=7)"]]in no coordinate plane[[/if]].
  • \(({@p3[1]@},\,{@p3[2]@},\,{@p3[3]@})\): [[if test="is(c3=1)"]]on the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c3=2)"]]on the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c3=3)"]]on the z-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c3=4)"]]in the xy-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c3=5)"]]in the yz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c3=6)"]]in the xz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c3=7)"]]in no coordinate plane[[/if]].
  • \(({@p4[1]@},\,{@p4[2]@},\,{@p4[3]@})\): [[if test="is(c4=1)"]]on the x-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c4=2)"]]on the y-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c4=3)"]]on the z-axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c4=4)"]]in the xy-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c4=5)"]]in the yz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c4=6)"]]in the xz-plane, not on an axis[[/if]][[if test="is(c4=7)"]]in no coordinate plane[[/if]].

questiondescription.text:
Vectors II: points on the axes and coordinate planes

Grade 12 CBE Core 2.6: Decide whether a point lies on an axis, in a coordinate plane or in neither, from its coordinates.

Core

This question is original to this project.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).

truefeedback.text:
[[if test="is(ch=1)"]]A point on the x-axis has y = 0 and z = 0.[[/if]][[if test="is(ch=2)"]]A point on the y-axis has x = 0 and z = 0.[[/if]][[if test="is(ch=3)"]]A point on the z-axis has x = 0 and y = 0.[[/if]][[if test="is(ch=4)"]]A point in the xy-plane has z = 0, and if it is not on an axis then x and y are not 0.[[/if]][[if test="is(ch=5)"]]A point in the yz-plane has x = 0, and if it is not on an axis then y and z are not 0.[[/if]][[if test="is(ch=6)"]]A point in the xz-plane has y = 0, and if it is not on an axis then x and z are not 0.[[/if]][[if test="is(ch=7)"]]A point in no coordinate plane has no coordinate equal to 0.[[/if]] [[if test="is(bm > 0)"]]But in \(({@p1[1]@},\,{@p1[2]@},\,{@p1[3]@})\), [[if test="is(bm=1)"]]x[[/if]][[if test="is(bm=2)"]]y[[/if]][[if test="is(bm=3)"]]z[[/if]] = \({@bv@}\), not 0.[[else]]But in \(({@p1[1]@},\,{@p1[2]@},\,{@p1[3]@})\), [[if test="is(em=1)"]]x[[/if]][[if test="is(em=2)"]]y[[/if]][[if test="is(em=3)"]]z[[/if]] = 0.[[/if]]

The coordinate that is 0 is the direction the point has not moved in.
